rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for remarks or attitudes that put someone down.

example.english: They are always making disparaging remarks that make people uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 佢成日講啲貶低人嘅說話，令人好唔舒服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 bin2 dai1 jan4 ge3 syut3 waa6 ling6 jan4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when the disparaging remark is sarcastic or mocking.

example.english: Your disparaging remarks are really rather unpleasant.
example.traditional: 你啲挖苦人嘅說話，真係幾難聽喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 di1 waa1 fu2 jan4 ge3 syut3 waa6 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 teng1 wo3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on insulting or humiliating someone.

example.english: Making such a disparaging remark in front of everyone is really too much.
example.traditional: 呢句侮辱人嘅說話，當住咁多人講真係好過分。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 mou5 juk6 jan4 ge3 syut3 waa6 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 gong2 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwo3 fan6
